summary: Repeated request; sender name still wrong, pushback unwelcome
detailed_context: Nick asked twice for sign-in emails to come from Permissions POC, Service Summary POC, or POC Hub at noreply@poc.nicholaswood.com.au. The previous response declined to build the per-app names and asked him to choose a route, because Firebase's built-in sender has one display name for the shared sign-in pool. Nick's reply, "A now, but all emails come from the POC Hub", accepts the address fix but restates the unmet part: every app still shows as POC Hub. Having to repeat the request and receiving a blocker rather than an option he could act on both count against the response. The lesson is to lead with a concrete path that delivers per-app sender names (for example, a custom mail sender or a per-app pool), or to state the tradeoff in one line and offer the choice, rather than only asking him to pick.
